items.name: Resort
items.overview: A debt-ridden room service boy rises to challenge a ruthless kitchen at a luxurious beachside haven.

items.name: Cousins And Kalyanams
items.overview: A 26-year tale of six cousins in Kerala whose lives and relationships revolve around seven weddings.

items.name: Brothers And Sisters
items.overview: Bound by love and unspoken truths, Shanmuga Sundaram and his devoted family's lives revolve around shared rituals... till hidden cracks begin to surface.

items.name: Batchmates
items.overview: When four wide-eyed first-year students enter the world of engineering, they undergo a rude shock as they face the harsh realities of college life.

items.name: Perfect Crown
items.overview: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

items.name: Dutton Ranch
items.overview: Rip Wheeler and Beth Dutton gamble everything on a new life in South Texas, but the promise of building a future far from the ghosts of Yellowstone quickly collides with brutal new realities and a rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire.

items.name: Pritam And Pedro
items.overview: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.

items.name: Part-Timers
items.overview: Two roommates, worlds apart, barely stay together. But these two women share one grand dream: a start-up.

items.name: 108 Base Hospital Uri
items.overview: Resilient army doctors at 108 Base Hospital, Uri, navigate personal and professional battles whilst saving lives in a conflict-torn zone.

items.name: The Court
items.overview: A young lawyer, brilliant with case details, struggles to find her place within the legal fraternity. Her two opponents: her celebrated father and her stammer.

items.name: Lanterns
items.overview: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

items.name: Ali Baba Aur 40 Bhoot
items.overview: Rooted in logic and science, Alisha is drawn into an experience that defies everything she believes. Will she find answers or uncover a terrifying truth?

items.name: Gunehgar Rishtey
items.overview: Delve into the real-life cases centred around relationships that took an ugly turn! Wrong choices, betrayals—what turned their stories into crime sagas?

items.name: The Madison
items.overview: The Clyburns uproot their comfortable New York City lives to the wild, untamed beauty of Montana's Madison River Valley on a search for connection.

items.name: Dear X
items.overview: Behind a beautiful face hides a cruel nature—Baek Ah-jin, who sees through and manipulates others' hearts. After stepping on the sacrifices of many to reach the top, everything begins to change the moment she arrives there. A woman wearing a mask to escape hell and climb to the highest place. And the story of the Xs being brutally crushed by her.

items.name: MobLand
items.overview: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

items.name: A Shop For Killers
items.overview: A niece who lost her parents and grew up in the hands of an uncle who runs a shopping mall faces a new truth after her uncle's sudden death.

items.name: Ayali
items.overview: Young Tamizhselvi dreams of becoming a doctor. But her village, Veerappannai, has fearsome age-old customs and traditions which inadvertently suppress women of the village. Will she be able to overcome them?

items.name: Flower Of Evil
items.overview: Hiding a twisted past, a man maintains his facade as the perfect husband to his detective wife — until she begins investigating a series of murders.

items.name: Code M
items.overview: Miltary lawyer,Major Monica Mehra,is roped in to solve, what seems like an open and shut case, of the death of an army officer, killed by militants in an encounter. The truth is far from what it appears to be. Will she crack the code?

items.name: 24: India
items.overview: Racing against the clock, ATU agent Jai Singh Rathod has 24 explosive hours in Mumbai to stop the assasination of the youngest ever Prime Minister.
